headline: Agreed to send four housing amendments to public hearing; three others wait until staff is in place.
summary: Tamara and Leon Lampes, owners of Broadway Auto Sales at 6 Dickey Street, asked the board to act as a go-between with town staff on a site plan issue. The chair said the board could not give feedback while the town is in litigation over the property. James Vayo of the Southern New Hampshire Planning Commission reviewed proposed housing rules, and that work is due by the end of September.
decisions: Agreed to send the first four housing land use amendments to public hearing and to hold the other three until staff is in place.

decision_evidence.quote: The approval of minutes was tabled.
The Board agreed to send the first four amendments to public hearing and to reserve addressing the other three until staff is in place.
